description: Angular component for editing and displaying SCADA symbol metadata, including form controls, validation, and code completion features.

classes.name: ScadaSymbolMetadataComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing SCADA symbol metadata, including form handling, validation, and code completion.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group and sets up value change subscription.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles input property changes, updates function completions if 'tags' change.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form group based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form with provided metadata value and updates code completion.

methods.name: editTagStateRenderFunction
methods.description: Triggers editing of tag's state render function.

methods.name: editTagClickAction
methods.description: Triggers editing of tag's click action.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form group, returns validation result.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: updateFunctionCompleters
methods.description: Updates code completion suggestions based on current metadata.
